comment: Which files the object-level measurement covers. The first matching rule decides; a tracked Go or Rust file that matches no rule is an error (nothing is left out silently). A change of this file is a change of the gate logic and is reviewed as such.

rules.reason: test code is not a production object
fixtures read by tests; Go tooling ignores testdata
a separate Go module (tools/goastdump/go.mod): measured and reported on its own, never averaged into the root module (owner decision 2026-11-14)
the measuring tool itself (a separate Go module); it is tested in the python job and is not an object of the Relay
live demo entry, exercised by make demo; already excluded from the coverage floors in verify.yml
live cgo demo entry, exercised by make demo-trustflow; excluded from the coverage floors in verify.yml
self-verifying demo entry, exercised by make demo-oci-sign; excluded from the coverage floors in verify.yml
every other Go file of the root module
integration tests are not production objects
every other Rust source (a #[cfg(test)] region inside a file is excluded by the object model, counted, not dropped)
